# BRAssetProvenance.h hop vectors (BRAssetHopClassify): the header's answers on real transactions, written
# down. Generated by vectors/asset-provenance-hop/generate.c, which describes each field; do not edit
# (asset_provenance_rules_kat checks it). The hop reads the carrier by the one carrier rule (BRTxAssetCarrier):
# only DA_TX_CARRIER is decoded, anything else is a dead end.
# hop <name> <tx hex> dead-end | transfer <parentTxid> | issuance <assetId> <supply> <div> <cid|-> <opcode> <locked>
